# misans

Original optional interface font assets from the user-supplied official font package.
Version: 4.009. Owner: Beijing Xiaomi Mobile Software Co., Ltd.. Source: <https://hyperos.mi.com/font/zh/>.

No files were subsetted, converted or modified. Full agreement is preserved in this directory.
The fonts are redistributed only bundled with SnowDesktop, never as standalone font products.
Settings and About retain prominent font attribution.
